title: Fracture
description: A hotshot prosecutor (Ryan Gosling) squares off against a cunning engineer (Anthony Hopkins) who tried to murder his wife and is now defending himself in court.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: One Crazy Summer
description: A budding cartoonist (John Cusack) helps a singer (Demi Moore) save her family home from a land developer on the island of Nantucket.

title: Frequency
description: Thirty years after the death of his father, a police officer is stunned to find himself communicating with him thanks to an old ham radio.

title: The Majestic
description: Residents of a 1950s coastal community mistake an amnesiac screenwriter for a soldier who never returned from the war.

title: Fandango
description: A prankster (Kevin Costner), an ROTC student (Judd Nelson) and their buddies hop in a Cadillac for one last fling in 1971 Texas.

title: The Good Lie
description: An employment counselor (Reese Witherspoon) dedicates her life to helping a group of Sudanese orphans find jobs and adjust to their new lives in America.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Alex & Me
description: Teenager Reagan Wills dreams of playing soccer like Alex Morgan, her hero. A poster of the soccer star magically comes to life in Reagan's bedroom, and Alex helps Reagan learn the value of determination.

title: The Accidental Tourist
description: A numb travel-writer (William Hurt) takes up with his dog trainer (Geena Davis) after his son dies and his wife (Kathleen Turner) leaves.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Rumble in the Bronx
description: A Hong Kong policeman (Jackie Chan) in New York defends a woman shopkeeper (Anita Mui) against bikers who want protection money.

title: Executive Decision
description: A commando squad must conduct a midair assault upon a hijacked plane loaded with terrorists and a deadly nerve gas.

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: Alien Autopsy
description: In the 1990s two men (Ant McPartlin, Declan Donnelly) produce a fake video that purports to be footage of an alien autopsy.

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: My Sister's Keeper
description: A girl (Abigail Breslin) who was conceived as a marrow donor for her gravely ill sister goes to court to seek emancipation and prevent further harvesting of her body tissue.

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: The Adventures of Pluto Nash
description: A nightclub owner finds himself in hot water when he refuses to sell his club to the local mob; the lunar gangsters are helping the mysterious Rex Crater mastermind a plan to take over the moon.

title: Big Girls Don't Cry... They Get Even
description: Their mixed-up family follows when an unhappy teen (Hillary Wolf) and her stepbrother flee into the woods.

title: Chaos Theory
description: After his wife (Emily Mortimer) plays a prank on him, an efficiency expert (Ryan Reynolds) finds himself subject to the random nature of life.

title: Boiler Room
description: Eager to win the approval of his demanding father, a young man (Giovanni Ribisi) begins working for a dubious stock firm.

title: Tenacious D in: The Pick of Destiny
description: Musicians JB (Jack Black) and KG (Kyle Gass) form rock group Tenacious D and set out on a quest for a legendary guitar pick that will make them the greatest band in the world.

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: National Lampoon's Loaded Weapon 1
description: A murdered policewoman's replacement (Emilio Estevez) continues a cocaine-cookie case with her ex-partner (Samuel L. Jackson).

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: Mr. Nice Guy
description: A gangster (Richard Norton) and his goons chase an ordinary guy (Jackie Chan) who helped a TV reporter (Gabrielle Fitzpatrick) escape their clutches.

title: Alex & Emma
description: A struggling writer (Luke Wilson) falls in love with a stenographer (Kate Hudson) while trying to finish his new novel in 30 days.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: While staying at a cabin in the woods, telepathic friends (Thomas Jane, Jason Lee) confront aliens that are being hunted by the military.

title: Clara's Heart
description: A housekeeper (Whoopi Goldberg) befriends the teenage son of the bickering Baltimore couple (Michael Ontkean, Kathleen Quinlan) who brought her from Jamaica.

title: Mr. Nanny
description: As a favor to his former trainer (Sherman Hemsley), a retired wrestler (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as a computer tycoon's (Austin Pendleton) bodyguard.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
description: Four tales include a bigot (Vic Morrow), oldsters who find youth in playing kick the can, a misunderstood boy, and a terrified man (John Lithgow) on a plane.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.
